interpretation.claim_text: Discounts above 15% require Finance (Head of Finance & People Ops) approval before the deal is closed.
interpretation.rationale: The focal passage establishes that discounts above 15% require Finance (Head of Finance & People Ops) approval. The passage states, "Anything over 15% goes to Harriet. That's been the rule since we bumped the threshold last year." This establishes the timing of the approval as before the deal is closed, as the passage implies that the approval is required before the deal is finalized.
